initial:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: hand-painted illustration BACKGROUND ONLY for a personal software maker's social-profile banner. Final canvas 3000 x 1000 pixels, aspect ratio 3:1.
Input image: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, showing existing illustrations from sebastian-software.com. Match the fine dark petrol ink outlines, watercolor pigment, paper texture, sage foliage, pale blue washes and muted ochre accents. Do not copy the calendar or the literal letters.
Primary request: an inviting, distinctive editorial illustration of a software craftsperson's workbench, with a small open laptop with a plain ivory screen, an open sketchbook with a few simple interconnected component shapes (no writing), a navy fountain pen, a short stack of reference books and a sage-green potted plant. Compose these as ONE coherent, beautifully drawn still life, not separate icons. A feeling of thoughtful engineering and useful tools made with care. Quiet sophistication, human and tactile, consistent with the reference website.
Composition: objects occupy ONLY the rightmost 38% of the canvas, from x=1850 to x=2900 and y=180 to y=850. The entire left 60% must remain almost empty off-white paper, for typography to be composited later. Keep the lower-left quarter empty for a circular profile photo overlapping the banner. A very faint watercolor wash may fade from the illustration toward the middle, with no hard edge or rectangle. All important objects remain inside the central 75% vertically because this will also be cropped to 4:1.
Palette: off-white #FAFCFC background, deep petrol #002731 outlines, muted ocean-blue watercolor, sage green, restrained golden ochre, warm parchment. Gentle natural desk shadows, irregular feathered watercolor edges.
Constraints: absolutely NO text, NO letters, NO logo, NO watermark, NO person, NO extra portrait, no browser chrome, no mockup frame. No photorealistic 3D objects, neon glow, gradients, floating dashboard cards, circuit patterns, stock-tech imagery, or oversized brand symbols. The original logo and precise vector typography will be layered separately later.
refinement:
Edit this illustrated banner background. Preserve the watercolor-and-ink style, off-white paper, petrol outlines, laptop, books, notebook, pen, sage plant, and palette.
Change ONLY the spatial composition: reduce the entire illustrated still-life cluster so that it occupies the RIGHTMOST 40% of the full 3:1 canvas (x=60% to 96%). Scale the cluster uniformly, keeping the objects together and legible. Leave the LEFT 58% as nearly empty off-white paper, with no objects, no lines, no symbols and only extremely faint paper texture. Keep every object and plant leaf INSIDE the middle 76% of the canvas height (y=12% to 88%) so a 4:1 crop preserves the illustration. The illustration should fade softly into the paper, with no frame or hard border. This is a background for later text and original-logo overlay. Do not add any text, logo, watermark, or people. Final aspect ratio 3:1.
